entries.summary: whisperIME documents an Android voice-input method and standalone speech-recognition app using Whisper, with initial model downloads followed by offline recognition.
entries.selection_context: Compare the documented IME, system voice-input and standalone transcription or translation modes.
entries.limitations: Check current Android compatibility, model download requirements, language support and recording limits. Publisher privacy and distribution-compatibility statements were reviewed as documentation; permission behavior and transcription quality were not independently tested.
entries.decision: Retain the published route as a dated unranked reference when absent from current discovery.

previous_references.summary: Nativ is a local AI application for Apple Silicon Macs. Its repository moved from Blaizzy/nativ to Neywa-Labs/nativ, retaining GitHub repository ID 1306758289.
previous_references.selection_context: Consult the current publisher documentation for local-model management and integrations. This existing Kymata URL preserves its former identity.
previous_references.limitations: Verify macOS, hardware, model and network-integration requirements. Publisher privacy claims are not an independent audit.

previous_references.summary: A locally hosted MCP server documented for adding web-search tools to local language-model clients.
previous_references.selection_context: Assess its search tools and client compatibility using publisher documentation.
previous_references.limitations: Search engines and remote sites are still contacted. Verify terms and dependencies; local hosting does not mean offline operation.

previous_references.summary: An on-device inference engine with documented bindings for local language-model, speech and application workflows.
previous_references.selection_context: Compare the publisher's platform bindings and model requirements for local inference integrations.
previous_references.limitations: Verify memory, GPU drivers, supported models and platform gaps. The documentation excludes Windows ARM64 and web export; local operation and performance were not independently tested.

previous_references.summary: A collection of pinned inference recipes, patches and measurement records for Intel Arc Pro B60/B70 hardware.
previous_references.selection_context: Use the publisher's decision guide and workload-specific evidence to identify a reproducible local inference setup.
previous_references.limitations: Results depend on the exact hardware, model, engine and timing protocol. Some speculative routes change greedy answers and historical speed records may not reproduce; no new benchmark result is asserted.

previous_references.summary: An adaptation of GraphRAG with local-model support, a central API and interfaces for indexing, prompt tuning and querying.
previous_references.selection_context: Inspect the publisher's setup and architecture notes when comparing local GraphRAG interfaces.
previous_references.limitations: The README warns about a major transition and possible instability, with primary testing on a Mac Studio M2. Verify dependency compatibility, data access and API exposure before use.

previous_references.summary: Historical Cactus Needle reference. The publisher now directs users to cactus-compute/cactus for code, documentation, releases and issues.
previous_references.selection_context: Use this existing URL to locate the publisher migration notice and current Cactus documentation rather than treating the former Needle repository as the current implementation.
previous_references.limitations: The saved catalog snapshot describes the earlier project. Its former ranking and metrics are not current. Verify the successor package requirements and migration instructions; no model, installation or benchmark was tested for this reference.
